data.narrative:
Enfabrica is a Series C-stage semiconductor company founded by Rochan Sankar and Shrijeet Mukherjee that has raised $311.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor names (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers in the same sector, with 3 same-stage private comparables directly applied.

Two valuation methods triangulate a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $311M raised proxy, yielding $529M. Peer-median methodology uses 3 same-sector, same-stage private comparables—Etched ($5.0B), d-Matrix ($2.0B), and DEEPX ($529M)—to establish a median implied value of $2.0B, with a range spanning $529M to $5.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is not applicable; the public semiconductor peer set carries a median multiple of 21.5x, but Enfabrica's revenue is not disclosed, precluding this method. The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $450M (low), $1.3B (median), and $2.3B (high). Key uncertainties include wide dispersion among same-stage peers, the absence of revenue disclosure for internal margin or efficiency assessment, and Enfabrica's competitive positioning relative to well-funded peers like Etched.
